I started out writing copy. Today I build the stories, launches and customer journeys that help people put new technology to work.

Flagship story
Dec 2025 – Present
Bengaluru, India

Bolna

Brand & Product Marketing Lead

As Bolna’s first marketing hire, I built the marketing function for a YC-backed voice AI platform serving Indian enterprises. My work runs from introducing a new speech model to helping a first-time builder make a test call.

Flagship project · November 2026 · Bengaluru

Symphony

My brief at Bolna’s first voice AI summit was to make the product legible on a busy expo floor. I worked with the booth teams on the experience-centre films, edited the motion and timing around their demos, and delivered the final cuts to the event crew.

Product launches

All areas
Product launch · 23 November 2026

Syl

A single “haan” can decide what happens next on a call. We introduced Syl at Symphony to catch the short replies that speech recognition often misses on a noisy phone line. The launch film lets you hear the difference.

Watch the Syl launch on X

Activation & retention

All areas

From signup to an agent test

I ran an onboarding experiment for new signups who had yet to build an agent. The rollout ran from October 13 to November 6, 2026. New signups were split roughly 60% to a welcome prompt plus a 24-hour email nudge, 30% to the prompt alone and 10% to a holdout.

Early activation across 522 signups

In our October 2026 onboarding experiment, 58.8% of signups assigned to the prompt-only group created an agent, compared with 48.9% in the holdout. The share who tested an agent was 43.1% versus 31.9%, a difference of 11.2 percentage points.

October 19 readout · Share of signups in each group
ExperienceSignupsCreated an agentTested an agent
Holdout4723 (48.9%)15 (31.9%)
In-app prompt15390 (58.8%)66 (43.1%)
Prompt and email322185 (57.5%)140 (43.5%)

At the October 19 readout, 43.5% of the group assigned to the additional email had tested an agent, compared with 43.1% in the prompt-only group. I used the findings to design the next checklist around the step each returning builder had reached.

Measuring the next step

I tracked checklist use, agent creation and first test calls in PostHog, then compared the cohorts to see where people stopped. For builders who wanted a live walkthrough, we ran The Voice Hour.

Public session announcement

The Voice Hour invited new builders to work through creating their first agent. The post documents the session. The onboarding experiment was tracked internally.
